impact: The 4000 ms deadline, the 60-80 s computation, the never-promoted private result and the requirement that every caller answer by the deadline cannot coexist: waiting violates the deadline, cancelling means a cold computation never succeeds, and detaching lets a short-lived MCP or CLI process exit on EOF and kill the only computation — while the never-promoted rule means finished work benefits nobody. FILED AS ISS-079 (critical) because it is a defect in the ticket's stated design. All three coherent resolutions are owner decisions and two of them route through the parked T-011: let the holder wait the measured pipeline bound (needs a durable result, contradicting never-promoted), own background computation in a persistent service (T-011), or promote an atomic cache result under shared writer authority (T-011's authority, and it makes the lease a correctness boundary rather than the optimization the ticket calls it).
title: [correctness] The 4000 ms deadline, the 60-80 s computation, the never-promoted private result
